description.value: The Courtney Room is an award-winning fine dining restaurant located in the Magnolia Hotel, two blocks from Victoria's Inner Harbour. It offers seasonally driven menus built on classic European techniques and locally sourced ingredients including in-house dry-aged beef, sustainable seafood, and produce from local farm partners. The restaurant earned Restaurant of the Year at the 2024 YAM Magazine Best Restaurant Awards and Platinum Distinction in the 2025 VIWF Wine Program Excellence Awards.
